name: CM42_the_store_runs_what_it_lists
origins: user requirement 2026-10-21 (a Steam-like store that runs our games and the products of our software, working as one software)

provenance.renumbered: CM39 on that branch, CM42 at the fold into the self-run

statement: The store runs what it lists: every game in the arcade's catalogue is built from its cards, served by the arcade service, downloaded with every chunk's and file's SHA-256 checked, installed, verified, repaired after damage, and launched natively, drawing a frame; a catalogue item that cannot do all of that is a failure the cycle reports, never a listing.
